entries.heading: PROHIBITION ON CONSTRUCTION OF PROVISIONS OF THIS TITLE AS AN AUTHORIZATION FOR THE USE OF MILITARY FORCE
entries.text:
SEC. 182. PROHIBITION ON CONSTRUCTION OF 
                        PROVISIONS OF THIS TITLE AS AN 
                        AUTHORIZATION FOR THE USE OF MILITARY 
                        FORCE.

    Nothing in this title may be construed as an authorization for the 
use of military force.
